Join compound_records and docs to retrieve compound_key and pubmed_id_or_doi. Join assays for assay description. Join target_dictionary for target ChEMBL ID, name, and organism. Filter by standard_type IC50 and target CHEMBL3430885. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by all output columns.
